reads.notes: SEAM: GET /api/hub/learn/entitlement. tier is computed client-side from creatorGates(currentSession).tier ?? 'basic' — even when isCreator is false. freeCoursesTotal is 0 whenever isCreator is false (plain 'user' accounts get zero free-course slots, so getCourseEntitlementState always returns 'exhausted' for them). freeCoursesTotal is 1 for basic tier, 3 for pro tier per freeCoursesTotalFor(). canDownloadPlaybook is hardcoded true in the mock (never varies) — the mock never actually gates the playbook download by entitlement despite the field existing. The gate consulted is creatorGates().isCreator / .tier — NOT .canUpload or .canEarn — so an accountType:'creator' record with subscriptionPaid:false is not distinguished from one that has paid; only accountType + the stored tier value drive the free-course count here.

reads.pagination: none — full list of 6 courses returned in one call, no page/cursor params, no infinite scroll
reads.notes: SEAM: GET /api/hub/learn/courses. Landing page (learn/page.tsx) shows courses.slice(0,3) — client-side truncation, not a server-side 'featured' filter. No price field anywhere: courses have no in-app Naira price, only a free-course-slot entitlement.

SEAM comment says 'GET /api/hub/content/:id' (both in learn.ts and mocks/learn.ts) — this looks like a copy-paste mismatch against the content-detail domain's endpoint; the actual mock function (getMockCourse) looks up MOCK_COURSES by id and returns LearnCourse | null, an entirely different shape from the Content entity used elsewhere. Flagged as a discrepancy for reconciliation, not silently treated as /api/hub/content/:id. Returns null when id is not found (drives the 'course not found' UI state).

SEAM: GET /api/hub/learn/playbook. There is exactly one playbook in the mock (MOCK_PLAYBOOK, id 'pb-business') — the UI never fetches a playbook by id, always the singleton. readingSections powers the in-app 'Read here' toggle view; chapters power the overview 'Inside' table of contents.

filtersOrSort: client-side filter by kind==='country' on the country-guides list page; client-side find-by-id on the guide-detail page — both operate on the same single GET /api/hub/learn/guides response, no server-side kind or id query param exists
reads.pagination: none — 12 country guides + 1 article + 1 template returned in one call
reads.notes: SEAM: GET /api/hub/learn/guides. Discriminated union on `kind`. All 12 country guides in the mock share the exact same crossSell object (NEPC_CROSS_SELL) by reference.

actions.name: enrolInCourse

payload.name: courseId
payload.note: sent as a path param per the SEAM comment (POST /api/hub/learn/courses/:id/enrol), not a body field

actions.notes: SEAM: POST /api/hub/learn/courses/:id/enrol. Triggered from EnrolCourseCta's CTA button, only when alreadyEnrolled is false (idempotent no-op client-side otherwise — mock is also idempotent server-side). The mock computes `cap` (freeCoursesTotalFor(tier) or 0) CLIENT-SIDE in learn.ts and passes it into enrolInCourseMock purely for local validation ('if slot available') — a real backend must derive the cap itself server-side from the creator's own tier/subscription record, never accept it from the client. After the call resolves (or is skipped because already enrolled), the CTA unconditionally opens `alisonHandoffUrl(courseId)` (a client-only string template, `https://alison.com/course/:id` — not a backend call) in a new tab. Enrolling does not touch Naira anywhere — no price, no wallet, no purchase record; it only spends a subscription-tier perk slot.

authContext.gateChecked: creatorGates(currentSession).isCreator and .tier — NOT .canUpload or .canEarn. The Learn screen is reachable and browsable by any logged-in account; only the free-course entitlement math branches on isCreator/tier. Neither subscriptionPaid nor kycStatus is read directly by this screen's data layer (per CLAUDE.md's rule to always go through creatorGates(), but this screen only consumes two of its five exposed fields).

special.downloadsNote: Playbook page and TemplatePack guide detail both render a DownloadButton (component out of this screen's read scope, not in uiFiles/dataFiles) for the PDF playbook and the template-pack files respectively; no download endpoint or SEAM comment exists in learn.ts/mocks/learn.ts for the actual file bytes — only playbook.downloadCount (a read-only counter) is modeled. A real download endpoint contract is implied by the UI but not documented anywhere in this screen's data layer.
special.externalHandoff: Course consumption itself is 100% external: alisonHandoffUrl() opens https://alison.com/course/:id in a new tab. There is no in-app course player and no PPV unlock — enrolling only spends the WAWU-tracked entitlement slot, the actual course content lives entirely on Alison.

uiStatesDesigned.frame: 1 · Landing — entitlement first, then both kinds
uiStatesDesigned.describes: Learn home: entitlement banner ('1 free course available · Comes with your Basic tier' + TierBadge), Start-here Playbook card, Courses section (one row 'Use your free course' StatusPill, one row mid-progress 40% bar), Playbooks-and-guides list (Country guides / article / template rows)

uiStatesDesigned.frame: 2 · Course — entitlement, then a named handoff
uiStatesDesigned.describes: Course detail: HandoffPill('Alison'), title/meta, entitlement panel ('Covered by your tier · This uses your 1 free course' + 'Pro carries three. Basic carries one'), overview, 'What it covers' checklist, sticky 'Enrol on Alison' CTA

uiStatesDesigned.frame: 3 · Playbook — free to everyone, download or read
uiStatesDesigned.describes: Playbook overview: cover thumbnail, PriceChip(free), description, 'Inside' chapter list (5 chapters), download-count strip, side-by-side Download / Read here buttons

uiStatesDesigned.frame: 4 · Country guides — the requirement in the subtitle
uiStatesDesigned.describes: Country guides list: intro copy, ListRow per country (7 shown of 12) with a requirement-style subtitle per row, footer count '12 countries · reviewed quarterly'

uiStatesDesigned.frame: 5 · Article — reference that routes into a service
uiStatesDesigned.describes: Country guide detail (Ghana): title/meta, two StatBlocks (duty %, border days), 'Why Ghana first' section, 'What you need' checklist, NEPC cross-sell card routing to /services/nepc/apply

uiStatesDesigned.frame: 6 · Pro — 2 of 3 left, spent slot shown as enrolled
uiStatesDesigned.describes: Courses list for a Pro-tier creator: entitlement card ('2 of 3 free courses left' with a 3-segment progress bar, TierBadge('pro')), course rows showing one 'Enrolled — free' StatusPill and three 'Use a free course' StatusPills

uiStatesDesignedNote: All 6 frames in design/screens/WAWU Learn.dc.html are happy-path/success states only — no loading, error, empty, or 'not found' frame is present anywhere in the design source for this screen. Every loading/error/not-found state listed under uiStatesHandled above is implementation-only, with no corresponding design frame.
